notes.title: AIRAC - 0.3.2
notes.content:
Hello controllers! A new stability update has landed.

[h3]We have added the following [b]features[/b]:[/h3]

[h3]We have fixed the following [b]bugs[/b]:[/h3]

+ Fix Remove traildots of departing aircraft
+ Fix unpausing returns game back to previous game speed

We are still working to improve the simulator and we need your help, drop by our Discord (https://discord.gg/X9ZhTA8V) and tell us about problems you have had or new features you would like.

notes.title: AIRAC - 0.3.0 - Departures!
notes.content:
Hello controllers! A new game mechanic has landed, [b]departures[/b]!

[h3]We have added the following [b]features[/b]:[/h3]
+ Managed and selected speed logic
+ Standard Instrumental Departures (SIDs)
+ Add posibility to put ;NONE; in STR, TRAN and IAC files for ALT CST, ALT ASSIGNED and SPD CST
+ VNAV target altitude in STR files
+ Traffic schedule enhancements
+ If DCT to NAVAID is given to an aircraft with route, it will continue to follow the route after


[h3]We have fixed the following [b]bugs[/b]:[/h3]
+ Fix Initial altitude detection in VNAV
+ LEAVE is now a synonym word for AFTER
+ Fix magnetic declination close to equator, now all heading are magnetic
+ Fix CTD if MRVA not complete
+ Fix GEO and MRVA buttons

This update is followed by a 10% discount in the game too :)

We are still working to improve the simulator and we need your help, drop by our Discord (https://discord.gg/X9ZhTA8V) and tell us about problems you have had or new features you would like.

Remain on frequency :)

notes.title: AIRAC - 0.2.0 - HOLDs introduced!
notes.content:
Hello controllers! A new update has landed! This is a big one!

[h3]We have added the following [b]features[/b]:[/h3]
+ [b]Holdings[/b] are here! A new command is available: Callsign, HOLD [over/at/on], NAVAID.
+ All [b]holding entries[/b] are modeled: direct, teardrop and parallel
+ Traffic will also now hold as published in the .HOLD files if they have no further clearances.
+ Prefbar HOLD toggling
+ Prefbar IAC toggling
+ [b]Colored polygons[/b] in .DRAW file
+ [b]Pilot delay[/b]
+ Review voice delete memory button
+ New voice command: Callsign, CONTACT tower on frequency 1 1 8 decimal 1 5 5

[h3]We have fixed the following [b]bugs[/b]:[/h3]
+ Workshop folder upload bug
+ Official airports updating correctly now
+ Initial altitude above VNAV constraints
+ Pref bar TRAN toggle

We are still working to improve the simulator and we need your help, drop by our Discord (https://discord.gg/X9ZhTA8V) and tell us about problems you have had or new features you would like.

Remain on frequency :)
